$comment: Row selector and per-suite expectations for the vendored external sframe-wg vectors. `cipher_suites` is the SHARED selector, declared once here as data and read by BOTH gates (crates/media-vector-gen/tests/external_sframe_gate.rs and packages/sdk-core/src/media/frame/__tests__/). A selector written once per language would be two implementations plus an agreement, and agreements drift: the two gates could narrow to different subsets while both reported green.
$required_fields_why: Anti-vacuity on the ARTIFACT, distinct from the anti-vacuity on the selector. If an upstream re-vendor drops or renames a field, a gate that reads it as absent would compare nothing and report success. Both gates assert every listed field is present on every selected row before comparing anything.

expectations.name: AES_128_GCM_SHA256_128
expectations.$why_no_aead: AES-128. Driving this row through seal/open would need an AES-128-capable code path, i.e. building a weak-key acceptance path into our crypto in order to test that we do not have one. WebCrypto does not refuse a 16-byte AES-GCM key, so the refusal must be ours. This row terminates at the key-schedule output.
expectations.$role_note: CONTRAST, not fallback. It makes 'the PRK is 64 bytes and the hash is SHA-512' falsifiable rather than self-referential. Ciphersuite 0x0005 is present at the pinned commit, so the task's precedence ladder resolves on its primary branch with nothing degraded.

expectations.name: AES_256_GCM_SHA512_128
expectations.$role_note: The suite ADR-0036 §4 selects (RFC 9605 §8.1). This row is the no-correlated-error gate on our HKDF-SHA512 key schedule and the AES-256-GCM primitive.
